title: Loops
summary: Repeat work without repeating yourself, with for loops, while loops and the patterns built from them.
outcomes: Repeat code a set number of times with for and range()
Keep going until a condition changes with while
Use break and continue to control a loop
Nest loops to draw grids and tables
Apply loop patterns such as counting, totalling and searching

lessons.title: for loops and range()
lessons.summary: Repeat code with for, and count with range().

lessons.title: while loops
lessons.summary: Repeat while a condition is true, and learn how to stop.

lessons.title: Loops inside loops
lessons.summary: Nest one loop inside another to build tables, grids and patterns.

lessons.title: Loop patterns
lessons.summary: Learn the handful of loop recipes behind most programs.

gameSummary: Steer through asteroid mazes with loops. A few lines can cover a long route.
